definitions.explanation: A furnished sample unit of a condominium (マンション) that is being sold, often before the building is finished, so that buyers can see the layout and fittings. A Japanese coinage from English "model" and "room".

examples.japanese: モデルルーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧モデルルーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new show flat opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: モデルルーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The furniture in a show flat is stylish, so it looks bigger than the real apartment will.

notes:
For a new condominium the show flat is usually built in a separate gallery near the site, since the building itself is not finished; for a detached house the word is ⟦モデルハウス→モデルハウス：33988_moderuhausu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- モデルルーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view a show flat
- モデルルーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go and see a show flat
- モデルルーム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: an appointment to view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦モデルハウス→モデルハウス：33988_moderuhausu⟧: a model home (a detached house)
- ⟦{住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう}→住宅展示場：34008_juutakutenjijou⟧: a park of model homes
